prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12, census item 4: cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_charter_held.py repoints address.ROOTS['instance'] at a scratch dir; on Windows there is no unix socket, so db_domain's store._conn_args() builds passfile from instance_path('db_domain', 0) under that scratch root, which holds no pgpass, and psycopg2 fails with 'fe_sendauth: no password supplied'. Linux never hits it because the socket branch needs no passfile.
